none: PAS NLM-BC6F07: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Darkened by treatment with oil by the finder and with encrusted reverse. Obverse description: Bust ?diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: probably Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16.6mm,…
